method: Read-only mesh.calc_tangents on original bind geometry
space: Mesh-local ORIGINAL bind geometry, never evaluated animated vertices. B=cross(N,T)*sign; transform actual normals by inverse-transpose. Unity FBX handedness C=ReflectX*B requires explicit independent frame conversion, not a guessed map flip.
regionMasks: Normalized bind-height spatial bins; diagnostic labels, not semantic garment segmentation
